healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the Typeform connector. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.

forms.list.action.title: List Forms
forms.list.action.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all Typeform forms in the workspace. Supports filtering by search query and pagination parameters.

search.description: Search query to filter forms by title.

workspace_id.description: Filter forms by workspace ID (Composio alias).

totalItems.description: Total number of forms matching the query.

forms.get.title: Get Form
forms.get.description: Retrieve a single Typeform form by its ID, including all fields, settings, and metadata.

formId.description: The unique identifier of the Typeform form.

form.description: The normalized form object including title, fields, and metadata.

forms.create.title: Create Form
forms.create.description: Create a new Typeform form with the specified title, fields, and settings.

title.description: The title of the new form.

fields.description: Array of field objects to include in the form.

settings.description: Form settings such as language, progress bar visibility, etc.

type.description: Form type such as quiz, classification, score, or branching.

logic.description: Conditional logic jumps and variable calculations.

forms.update.title: Update Form
forms.update.description: Replace an existing Typeform form with a complete definition. This is a full replacement (PUT); omitted fields, logic, hidden values, screens, settings, or theme data may be removed or reset by Typeform.

formId.description: The unique identifier of the form to update.

title.description: The new title for the form.

logic.description: Complete logic rules for the replacement form.

hidden.description: Complete list of hidden field references for the replacement form.

theme.description: Complete theme definition for the replacement form.

type.description: Complete form type, such as quiz or score.

variables.description: Complete score, price, and custom variable definition for the replacement form.

workspace.description: Workspace reference for the replacement form.

forms.delete.title: Delete Form
forms.delete.description: Permanently delete a Typeform form and all its associated responses.

formId.description: The unique identifier of the form to delete.

deleted.description: Whether the form was successfully deleted.

formId.description: The ID of the deleted form.

responses.list.action.title: List Form Responses
responses.list.action.description: Retrieve a paginated list of responses for a specific Typeform form. Supports filtering by date range and cursor-based pagination.

formId.description: The unique identifier of the form whose responses to retrieve.

since.description: Limit to responses submitted after this ISO 8601 datetime.

until.description: Limit to responses submitted before this ISO 8601 datetime.

after.description: Token to retrieve the next page of responses (cursor).

before.description: Token to retrieve the previous page of responses (cursor).

query.description: Search string matched against response fields.

fields.description: Limit displayed answer fields to these field IDs.

response_type.description: Filter by started, partial, or completed.

answered_fields.description: Filter responses containing these field IDs.

totalItems.description: Total number of responses for the form.

responses.delete.title: Delete Form Responses
responses.delete.description: Delete specific responses from a Typeform form by their response tokens.

formId.description: The unique identifier of the form.

includedTokens.description: Array of response token IDs to delete.

included_response_ids.description: Comma-separated list of response IDs to delete (max 1000).

deleted.description: Whether the responses were successfully deleted.

webhooks.create.title: Create or Update Webhook
webhooks.create.description: Create or update a webhook for a Typeform form. Webhooks are identified by a tag; creating with an existing tag updates the webhook.

formId.description: The unique identifier of the form to attach the webhook to.

tag.description: A unique tag to identify this webhook within the form.

url.description: The URL to receive webhook payloads.

enabled.description: Whether the webhook is active (default true).

verifySsl.description: Whether to verify SSL certificates for the webhook URL.

verify_ssl.description: Whether to verify SSL certificates during webhook delivery.

event_types.description: Event types that trigger the webhook, e.g. form_response.

webhook.description: The created or updated webhook object.

webhooks.list.title: List Webhooks
webhooks.list.description: List all webhooks configured for a specific Typeform form.

formId.description: The unique identifier of the form whose webhooks to list.

users.me.title: Get About Me
users.me.description: Get information about the owner account in Typeform.

workspaces.list.title: List Workspaces
workspaces.list.description: Retrieve all workspaces in a Typeform account with IDs, names, form counts, and members.

workspaces.get.title: Get Workspace
workspaces.get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific workspace including its name, forms, and team members.

workspace_id.description: Unique identifier for the workspace (Composio alias).

workspaces.create.title: Create Workspace
workspaces.create.description: Create a new workspace in Typeform for organizing forms by team or project.

name.description: The name of the workspace to create.

workspaces.create_in_account.title: Create Account Workspace
workspaces.create_in_account.description: Create a new workspace in a specific Typeform account using the account ID.

name.description: Name of the new workspace to create.

accountId.description: ULID identifier for the account where the workspace will be created.

workspaces.update.title: Update Workspace
workspaces.update.description: Update a workspace name or manage team member access using JSON Patch operations.

name.description: Convenience rename; sent as a JSON Patch replace on /name.

operations.description: JSON Patch operations to apply (replace /name, add/remove /members).

workspaces.delete.title: Delete Workspace
workspaces.delete.description: Delete a workspace. The default My Workspace cannot be deleted, and workspaces that still contain forms return an error.

themes.list.title: List Typeform Themes
themes.list.description: Retrieve a paginated list of public and private themes in the Typeform account.

themes.get.title: Get Theme
themes.get.description: Retrieve a theme's configuration including colors, fonts, and layout settings.

theme_id.description: Unique ID for the theme (Composio alias).

themes.create.title: Create Theme
themes.create.description: Create a custom Typeform theme with colors, fonts, background, and layout settings.

font.description: Font choice from predefined Typeform options (e.g. Karla, Arial, Georgia).

colors.description: Color configuration with answer, background, button, and question hex values.

screens.description: Welcome/thank-you screen alignment and font size.

rounded_corners.description: Border radius: none, small, or large.

has_transparent_button.description: Whether the button should be transparent.

themes.update.title: Update Theme
themes.update.description: Replace a theme's complete definition. Requires name, font, and colors. Cannot modify Typeform public themes.

themeId.description: Unique identifier for the theme to update.

theme_id.description: Unique identifier for the theme (Composio alias).

font.description: Font family for the theme (required for PUT).

colors.description: Updated color palette with question, answer, button, and background colors.

rounded_corners.description: Border radius style: none, small, or large.

themes.patch.title: Update Theme (Partial)
themes.patch.description: Partially update a Typeform theme. Each provided object (e.g. colors) must be complete. Cannot modify public built-in themes.

themeId.description: Unique ID for the theme to update.

theme_id.description: Unique ID for the theme (Composio alias).

rounded_corners.description: Rounded corners: none, small, or large.

has_transparent_button.description: Whether the button should be transparent.

themes.delete.title: Delete Theme
themes.delete.description: Permanently delete a theme from the Typeform account. This cannot be undone.

images.list.title: List Images
images.list.description: Retrieve all images in the Typeform account in reverse-chronological order.

images.create.title: Create Image
images.create.description: Upload a new image via base64 encoding or URL. Either image (base64) or url must be provided.

fileName.description: The name assigned to the image file.

file_name.description: The name assigned to the image file (Composio alias).

image.description: Base64 image data without a data:image descriptor.

url.description: Direct link to an existing image online.

images.delete.title: Delete Image
images.delete.description: Delete an image from the Typeform account. Returns success on 204 No Content.

imageId.description: The unique identifier for the image to remove.

image_id.description: The unique identifier for the image (Composio alias).

images.get.title: Get Image By Size
images.get.description: Retrieve a Typeform image optimized for desktop (default), mobile, or thumbnail.

imageId.description: Unique identifier for the image to retrieve.

image_id.description: Unique identifier for the image (Composio alias).

size.description: Image size: default (800px width), mobile (460px), or thumbnail (80x50).

images.background.get.title: Get Background By Size
images.background.get.description: Retrieve a background image scaled for default, tablet, mobile, or thumbnail.

imageId.description: Unique identifier for the image resource.

image_id.description: Unique identifier for the image (Composio alias).

images.choice.get.title: Get Choice Image By Size
images.choice.get.description: Retrieve a picture-choice image at a specific size.

imageId.description: Unique ID for the image to retrieve.

image_id.description: Unique ID for the image (Composio alias).

webhooks.get.title: Get Webhook
webhooks.get.description: Retrieve a single webhook by form ID and webhook tag.

tag.description: Unique name assigned to the webhook.

webhooks.delete.title: Delete Webhook
webhooks.delete.description: Delete a webhook configuration from a Typeform form. Returns 204 on success.

forms.messages.get.title: Get Form Messages
forms.messages.get.description: Retrieve custom messages for a Typeform including button labels, error messages, and UI text.

formId.description: Unique form identifier found in the form URL.

forms.messages.update.title: Update Form Messages
forms.messages.update.description: Update custom messages for form UI elements such as buttons, errors, and placeholders.

messages.description: Raw Typeform message map using dotted keys.

label_button_submit.description: Text for the submit button (max 100 characters).

label_error_required.description: Error message shown when a required field is empty (max 64 characters).

label_button_hint_default.description: Tooltip text for the continue button (max 28 characters).

block_short_text_placeholder.description: Placeholder text for short text input fields (max 100 characters).

label_button_no_answer_default.description: Text for the Continue without answering button (max 100 characters).

forms.patch.title: Patch Form
forms.patch.description: Partially update a Typeform using JSON Patch operations without replacing the entire form.

formId.description: Unique form identifier found in the form URL.

operations.description: JSON Patch operations (add/remove/replace) to apply to the form.

responses.files.get.title: Get All Response Files
responses.files.get.description: Download a zip archive of all files respondents uploaded for a form. Returns empty=true when the form has no file-upload fields (204).

formId.description: Unique identifier of the form to download response files for.

videos.upload.title: Upload Video
videos.upload.description: Initiate a video upload and obtain a signed upload_url. PUT the video bytes to that URL after this call.

formId.description: Unique form identifier where the video will be attached.

fieldId.description: Field ID where the video media belongs within the form.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code for automatic transcription (e.g. en).

video.description: Video id and signed upload URL.

webhook.form_response.title: New Form Response
webhook.form_response.description: Triggers when a respondent completes and submits a Typeform form.
